summary: Identity mirror power and transformation. This polarized pattern asks you to use confidence and depth with awareness.
body: Identity mirror power and transformation. This polarized pattern asks you to use confidence and depth with awareness. Power runs to extremes and relationships tip into control struggles. The two sides may appear through contrast, projection, or relationships until you learn to hold both directly. In practice, this can show up through identity, power and transformation, and the choices you make when ego defense or control starts running the room.
gift: The gift is confidence, depth, and a more conscious way to work with identity and power and transformation.
shadow: The shadow is ego defense, control, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let identity and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
do: Name how identity and power and transformation are both involved
Pause before choosing the most familiar reaction
Turn confidence and depth into one concrete choice
dont: Let ego defense make the decision
Treat tension as proof that something is wrong
Ignore the needs of identity or power and transformation
